description: The individual calls on one race or chamber, newest first: who said it, when, what they picked or the number they named, a short excerpt of their wording, and the pundit's graded election record from past cycles. raceSlug comes from election_races, or is chamber:senate, chamber:house or national:house-vote.

cycle.description: The cycle, for a chamber or the national vote. Omit for the current cycle.

raceSlug.description: A race slug from election_races, or chamber:senate, chamber:house or national:house-vote.

name: election_race_calls
title: Calls on one election race
